title: Law to create a City office helping building conversions
summary: This bill would require the mayor to establish an Office of Conversion Assistance to help developers and owners convert non-residential buildings into housing. The office would provide technical help, run an online portal, coordinate with city, state and federal agencies, and identify obstacles to conversions. It must report annually to the Speaker, mayor and Public Advocate on conversion activity and affordable units created, starting within 12 months of the law taking effect.
